properties.displayName: UAV S22 - Mission Sequence Forced Reset Loop (mission_reset burst)
properties.description: UAVMissionEvent_CL에서 mission_reset 버스트 또는 mission_abort 2회 이상 탐지. 실제 컬럼: MissionId 없음 → UAVId+Seq 사용. MITRE: T0828 Loss of Productivity (ICS — description 참조)
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 15m;
let maxResetPerMin = toscalar(
    _GetWatchlist('UAV_Threshold_List')
    | where ThresholdKey == 'MaxMissionResetPerMin'
    | project toreal(Value));
UAVMissionEvent_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
| where EventName in ('mission_reset', 'mission_abort', 'waypoint_skip')
| summarize
    ResetCount=countif(EventName == 'mission_reset'),
    AbortCount=countif(EventName == 'mission_abort'),
    MinSeq=min(Seq), MaxSeq=max(Seq)
    by UAVId, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)
| where ResetCount > (maxResetPerMin * 5) or AbortCount > 2
| extend TriggerReason = case(
    AbortCount > 2, strcat("임무_강제중단_", tostring(AbortCount), "회"),
    strcat("MISSION_RESET_버스트_", tostring(ResetCount), "회/5min"))
| extend Severity = "Medium"
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, ResetCount, AbortCount, MinSeq, MaxSeq, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S22 - Mission Sequence Forced Reset Loop (mission_reset burst) - {{UAVId}}
